verdict.rationale: 1Password documents first-party machine-identity credentials: Service Accounts for automation, and a Credential Broker that gives machine workflows short-lived access to secrets without managing service account tokens. Short-lived access is a form of least privilege. However, the evidence never shows vault- or permission-level scoping of these credentials, and never frames them as agent-specific. missing for 10: documented per-vault/per-permission scoping of service account or broker credentials, explicit agent-oriented credential issuance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Use the 1Password Credential Broker to give CI/CD and other machine workflows short-lived access to secrets, without managing service account tokens.
1Password Service Accounts help automate secrets management in your applications and infrastructure without the need to deploy additional services.
